According to legends, '''Q'rnaf B'lair''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who fell defending the [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] from [[Darth Malak]], and was one of the Jedi that Malak kept in stasis to draw power from aboard the [[Star Forge]].<ref name="GoH" /> B'lair was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Battle of Rakata Prime]] when Malak was defeated by [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and the Star Forge was destroyed.<ref name="Death" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Legends say Q'rnaf B'lair may have fallen defending the Jedi Enclave from Malak.|Portrait description|<ref name="GoH" />}}
Q'rnaf B'lair exclusively features as a collectible portrait in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]'' and in artwork for Darth Malak, depicting B'lair as one of the Jedi in stasis in the final level of the [[2003]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.
